Hey, I’m Garrett. I’m a sophomore studying Industrial Engineering at the University of Arkansas, with minors in Finance and Engineering Management. I’m drawn to the point where engineering meets people: making systems, organizations, and decisions work better, and then leading the effort to get there.

My leadership was shaped in the backcountry. I’m an Eagle Scout, and in summer 2026 I served as a Ranger at Philmont Scout Ranch in New Mexico. There I led and mentored crews in the backcountry, taught wilderness skills, and made risk-management calls when plans fell apart. Out there, I learned that leadership isn’t about authority. It’s about service, and about being trusted with people who are counting on you to get it right.

On the analytical side, I completed a finance internship with Service Academy Capital Management, where I researched markets, built portfolios, and presented on how AI is reshaping the financial industry. Going forward, I’m focused on operations research, systems analysis, and federal and defense work, where rigorous analysis shapes decisions that affect a lot of people.

I hold myself to a high standard in my work and in who I am. I’ve been given real opportunities, and I intend to make the most of them: to build a career that matters, to lead people well, and to leave every place I go better than I found it.

Outside of school and work, you’ll usually find me backpacking, camping, or spending time with friends. This site collects my projects, experience, and resume, so feel free to look around or reach out.
